Interface AetherisNotebookPanel.Host

All Known Implementing Classes:
SshClientApp
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
public static interface AetherisNotebookPanel.Host
The Host is the application side this panel calls. The host shows status text for the notebook. The host keeps the saved shell numbers for open-card rows, inspector wrap, the divider, the inspector line length, and the pin bar. The host owns the focused terminal session and the file chooser. A method that reads a saved number returns the stored value. A method whose name ends in Changed writes the value the panel just applied.
Author:
clayl (2026-09-02)

  • Method Details

    • focusedAmwpConnector

      SshTtyConnector focusedAmwpConnector()
      The method returns the live AMWP connector for the focused session. The connector is an SshTtyConnector. AMWP is the frame channel on that connector.
      Returns:
      the live AMWP connector, or null when no session is focused

    • aetherisStatus

      void aetherisStatus(String text)
      The method shows text as the notebook status line.
      Parameters:
      text - the status sentence the panel wants on screen

    • aetherisVaultShown

      void aetherisVaultShown(String username)
      The method tells the host that the vault for username is on screen. The vault is the client store for that user's canvas.
      Parameters:
      username - the sanitized vault user whose canvas is showing

    • shellViewRows

      int shellViewRows()
      The method returns the saved count of open-card rows. An open-card row is one visible row of canvas cards in the view.
      Returns:
      the saved open-card row count, and the count is at least 1

    • shellViewRowsChanged

      void shellViewRowsChanged(int rows)
      The method stores the open-card row count the panel just applied.
      Parameters:
      rows - the open-card row count now in use

    • shellWrapColumns

      int shellWrapColumns()
      The method returns the saved inspector wrap width. The wrap width is how many characters the inspector keeps on one line before it wraps.
      Returns:
      the saved wrap width in characters, and the width is at least 1

    • shellWrapColumnsChanged

      void shellWrapColumnsChanged(int columns)
      The method stores the inspector wrap width the panel just applied.
      Parameters:
      columns - the wrap width in characters now in use

    • shellInspectorDivider

      int shellInspectorDivider()
      The method returns the saved canvas and inspector divider. The divider is the bar between the canvas and the inspector. The unit is per mille, which is parts per thousand of the span beside that bar.
      Returns:
      the saved left share from 0 to 1000, or -1 when the saved key is absent

    • shellInspectorDividerChanged

      void shellInspectorDividerChanged(int perMille)
      The method stores the left share of the span beside the divider. The unit is per mille, which is parts per thousand of that span.
      Parameters:
      perMille - the left share the panel just applied, from 0 to 1000

    • shellInspectorLineChars

      int shellInspectorLineChars()
      The method returns the saved inspector line length. The line length is how many characters of body the inspector shows on one line. A missing saved key means 80.
      Returns:
      the saved character count, and the count is at least 1

    • shellInspectorLineCharsChanged

      void shellInspectorLineCharsChanged(int count)
      The method stores the inspector line length the panel just applied. The count is the number of body characters shown on one inspector line.
      Parameters:
      count - the character count now in use

    • shellPinBarOpen

      boolean shellPinBarOpen()
      The method returns whether the pin bar is open. The pin bar is the strip of pin controls above the canvas. A missing saved key means the bar is folded.
      Returns:
      true when the pin bar is open, and false when it is folded

    • shellPinBarOpenChanged

      void shellPinBarOpenChanged(boolean open)
      The method stores whether the pin controls are showing.
      Parameters:
      open - true when the pin controls are showing, and false when they are folded

    • chooseRememberedFile

      File chooseRememberedFile(Component parent)
      The method opens the file chooser the host remembers.
      Parameters:
      parent - the dialog owner, which is the window the chooser sits on
      Returns:
      the approved file, or null when the operator cancels

    • focusConnectedUser

      void focusConnectedUser(String username)
      The method moves the focused session to the connected user named username. The name is the sanitized connected user.
      Parameters:
      username - the sanitized name of the connected user to focus

    • aimFocusedAmwp

      void aimFocusedAmwp()
      The method aims the AMWP listener at the focused session. AMWP is the frame channel on that session. The method then delivers any frames the host was holding for that session.

    • focusedVaultUser

      String focusedVaultUser()
      The method returns the sanitized user of the focused session.
      Returns:
      the sanitized user, or an empty string when no session is focused

    • relayArmedMoods

      void relayArmedMoods()
      The method sets or clears the console mood on every connected pane whose user is armed. A mood is the token string the console keeps for that user. A pane that already matches the armed mood is left alone.

    • terminalSelection

      String terminalSelection()
      The method returns the highlighted text in the terminal.
      Returns:
      the highlighted terminal text, or an empty string when nothing is highlighted

    • terminalLastLine

      String terminalLastLine()
      The method returns the last non-empty line the terminal printed.
      Returns:
      the last non-empty line the terminal returned

    • confirmPtyWrite

      boolean confirmPtyWrite(Component parent, String preview)
      The method asks the operator to confirm a Scope T write. Scope T is the raw-byte write on the focused connector.
      Parameters:
      parent - the dialog owner, which is the window the question sits on
      preview - the text that would be written if the operator confirms
      Returns:
      true when the operator confirmed the Scope T write, and false otherwise

    • writePty

      void writePty(byte[] bytes) throws IOException
      The method writes raw bytes on the focused connector. The bytes are a Scope T write, which is the raw-byte path on that connector. The To terminal action does not call this method.
      Parameters:
      bytes - the Scope T bytes to write
      Throws:
      IOException - when the write fails, or when no terminal is focused and the failure text is no terminal

    • sendTerminalPaste

      void sendTerminalPaste(String text) throws IOException
      The method sends text as a bracketed paste on the focused terminal. A bracketed paste wraps the text so the terminal treats it as one paste. The method does not add a trailing Enter.
      Parameters:
      text - the cell text to paste
      Throws:
      IOException - when no terminal is focused, when the text is over the paste cap, or when the write fails
